SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id as comic_id, c.title, NULL as cover_url, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) as chapter_count, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.lq_status) as lq_status FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY c.id ) t
ORDER BY t.hq_size ORDER BY t.lq_size ORDER BY t.title ORDER BY (t.hq_size + t.lq_size)
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT c.id as comic_id, c.title, NULL as cover_url, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) as chapter_count, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.lq_status) as lq_status FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id WHERE c.id = #{comicId} GROUP BY c.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')

SELECT ch.id as chapter_id, ch.chapter_no, ch.title, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.lq_status) as lq_status FROM chapter ch LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE ch.comic_id = #{comicId} GROUP BY ch.id ORDER BY ch.sort_order
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.transcode_status) FROM comic c JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type = 'VIDEO' WHERE c.id = #{comicId}
